Harper (marketing): Launch note: tiny-refapp OSS post went live 06:40 PT. Strong early dev engagement. Proposing a short technical webinar + gated benchmark appendix to convert more leads.
Noel (devrel): Nice! Any first-hour metrics?

lead-bot: 2 leads failed routing: missing "utm_campaign" -> routed to manual-review queue.
Kim (ops): Can default missing utm_campaign -> "organic_refapp" and tag 'auto-defaulted' so SDRs can filter. Will stage change, then reprocess.
Rafael (runtime): FYI, the post currently lists ~latency measured at batch=1. Please add a clear bench note about batching vs throughput so readers don't misinterpret.
Noel (devrel): Agreed. Add: "Latency measured single-request (batch=1) on a small dedicated node; batching and different hardware change tokens/sec. Full configs in appendix."
Harper (marketing): Action list:
- Noel: update post copy + bench callout + A/B CTAs (EOD)
- Kim: patch routing default + reprocess missed leads (today)
- Rafael: confirm runtime segment + slides (tomorrow)
- Zara: build reg page + $450 promo plan (48h)
Zara (growth): CTA test: Variant A "Register for the live walkthrough" vs Variant B "Get the repo + benchmark appendix". Track CTR -> reg -> demo conversion.
Kim (ops): Reprocess command I'll run after deploy:
```bash
python infra/reprocess_leads.py --filter "missing_utm_campaign" --assign default:organic_refapp --tag auto-defaulted
```
Rafael (runtime): I'll tailor runtime slides for devs: KV cache behavior, batching tradeoffs, quantization notes. Ping me for config snippets.
Noel (devrel): Proposed webinar agenda: 8m intro, 20m hands-on demo, 20m benchmarks + infra, 10m Q&A.
